phases.sum: Iron Man, the Hulk, Thor and Captain America are introduced one at a time, then Nick Fury brings them together to stop Loki's alien invasion of New York. Thanos is revealed as the power behind it.
Infinity Stones keep surfacing. S.H.I.E.L.D. falls to HYDRA, the Guardians of the Galaxy form, and Tony's Ultron program nearly wipes out humanity. Thanos decides to collect the Stones himself.
The Avengers split over government control and Thanos wipes out half of all life. Five years later the survivors travel through time to undo it, at the cost of Tony Stark and Natasha Romanoff.

phases.peak: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
phases.sum: The world adjusts to everyone's return, new heroes take up old names, Loki breaks the single timeline into a multiverse, and Doctor Strange's spells pull in other universes.
Kang the Conqueror appears, the Fox mutant universe joins the multiverse, Sam Wilson becomes Captain America, and a team of misfits becomes the New Avengers as other worlds start arriving.
The Fantastic Four cross over from their own universe, Spider-Man meets the mutant Jean Grey, Vision reunites with his sons, and Doctor Doom faces heroes from three universes in Avengers: Doomsday.
